next.reason: 1985 relative READ: Format 1 READ f [NEXT] RECORD [INTO] [AT END][NOT AT END], Format 2 READ f RECORD [INTO] [INVALID KEY][NOT INVALID KEY], each pair in fixed order. §2023:14.9.30.2 adds PREVIOUS, ADVANCING ON LOCK, IGNORING LOCK, retry-phrase, WITH [NO] LOCK and puts the AT END/INVALID KEY pairs in choice indicators (either order); §2023:14.9.30.3 SR9 implies NEXT in dynamic mode when AT END is written, where 1985 SR3 required NEXT. The KEY phrase is not new for relative files (§2023:14.9.30.3 SR10 'only if ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED'). More forms accepted; 1985 forms keep their meaning. CHANGED (looser).
